answer: No identity may wander in unvouched. Three agents holding a cedar credential each stake $60 and sign a terrace record. Building 100 clones needs 60 verifiers and $48,000 locked 90 days, against $0 net for 100 honest identities, whose verifiers are refunded after 30 clean days. A dockmaster caught with one bad cargo loses his license and every ship he cleared.
